bulk.path: Triton fused kernel, fp16 tensor cores, fp32 accumulation (NVIDIA L40S)
bulk.exactness: every partial sum of products is bounded by |x||y| <= max squared norm = 32 (Cauchy-Schwarz), so every value is an integer held exactly in fp16/fp32 on the GPU (fp16 holds integers to 2^11)

second.how: plain Python integers, the test p <= 0 or 4p^2 <= AB written out; no numpy, no BLAS

contactRule: contact iff 4p^2 = AB (possible only between blocks whose AB is 4 times a square)
